requirement: The system shall require customer name, preferred contact method, service address, request category, and request description before standard submission.
acceptance_measure: A standard request cannot be submitted when any required field is blank.

current_issue: Duplicate records are difficult to identify
requirement: The system shall generate one unique request ID at initial creation and display it in all subsequent views and notifications.
acceptance_measure: Every created request receives a unique immutable identifier.

requirement: The system shall route new requests to a shared coordinator queue based on request category and priority.
acceptance_measure: Test requests appear in the correct queue within one minute of submission.

requirement: The system shall require one accountable owner for every active request and record ownership changes.
acceptance_measure: No active request can remain without an owner beyond the configured assignment interval.

requirement: The system shall prevent a request from moving to Scheduled status until required scheduling information is complete.
acceptance_measure: Status transition is blocked and missing fields are identified to the user.

requirement: The system shall send a confirmation containing the request ID and expected next step after successful submission.
acceptance_measure: A confirmation is logged for at least 95% of valid test submissions.

requirement: The system shall send configurable notifications when a request is scheduled, rescheduled, completed, or cancelled.
acceptance_measure: Each tested status change creates the correct notification and audit entry.

current_issue: Job details are spread across messages
requirement: The system shall provide technicians with a single job summary containing verified customer, location, service, schedule, and access information.
acceptance_measure: Technicians can view all approved job-summary fields from one record.

requirement: The system shall display backlog, average intake-to-schedule time, missing-information rate, duplicate rate, and service-level compliance by category.
acceptance_measure: Dashboard calculations match an independently checked test dataset.

current_issue: Customer data access is overly broad
requirement: The system shall enforce role-based access using least-privilege permissions for customer service, scheduling, technicians, managers, and administrators.
acceptance_measure: Permission tests confirm each role can access only approved records and actions.

requirement: The system shall load standard request and queue views within three seconds for at least 95% of pilot transactions.
acceptance_measure: Performance test results meet the response-time threshold.

requirement: The system shall retain an audit history of status, owner, schedule, and priority changes including user and timestamp.
acceptance_measure: Audit review shows complete before-and-after values for every tested material change.
